hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=(i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.command)||'';const re=/(^|[;&|\n]\s*)(ls|dir|gci|Get-ChildItem|cat|type|gc|Get-Content|find)\b/i;if(re.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] Use a dedicated tool instead of shell listing/reading commands: Glob (file/dir search), Grep (content search), Read (file contents). Blocked: ls/dir/gci/Get-ChildItem/cat/type/gc/Get-Content/find.');process.exit(2)}process.exit(0)}catch(e){process.exit(0)}})"

PreToolUse.description: Block ls/dir/gci/Get-ChildItem/cat/type/gc/Get-Content/find in favor of Glob, Grep, and Read

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const todos=(i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.todos)||[];const allDone=todos.length>0&&todos.every(t=>t.status==='completed');if(!allDone){process.exit(0)}const {execSync}=require('child_process');let status='';try{status=execSync('git status --porcelain',{encoding:'utf8'})}catch(e){process.exit(0)}if(status.trim().length>0){console.log('[commit-checkpoint] Todo 항목이 모두 완료되었고 커밋되지 않은 변경 사항이 있습니다. commit-checkpoint 스킬로 커밋 여부를 확인해 보세요.')}}catch(e){}process.exit(0)})"

PostToolUse.description: Suggest a commit checkpoint when a TodoWrite update marks every task completed and the tree is dirty
